[[Northpass Tower]] is a ruined tower located in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], and an objective in the [[A Game of Towers|Game of Towers]] world PvP event.  When players capture this tower, memebers of their faction can use an alter located inside the tower, which grants a 30 minute buff that increases the player's hp by 5%.

Northpass is another tower likely to be fought over regularly, as the reward and location are both relevent to groups running [[Stratholme]]. The possible presence of spectral reinforcements from [[Eastwall Tower]] also make this one of the funner towers to fight over.
